description:
Muse Dash is a rhythm game where you hit objects to the beat of one of 400+ songs.
Play through a selection of randomly chosen songs, collecting music sheets
until you have enough to play and complete the goal song!

v1.4.53.description:
# Changes
- Update songs to Song of Determination & Power
- If the mod fails to get datastorage values on startup, it should continue on and give you free items (for now) rather than crash internally and put the mod in a bad state.

# Installation
## Melonloader
*Melonloader is required to play with this mod.  However reinstalling it is not required on update.*

> You can find Muse Dash's folder by finding the game in your steam library, right clicking it and choosing *Manage→Browse Local Files*.

### Windows
1. Download `MelonLoader.Installer.exe` from https://github.com/LavaGang/MelonLoader/releases/latest and run it.
2. Select Muse Dash in the list of games.
   - If Muse Dash does not appear, click add game manually then browse to `MuseDash.exe`.
3. Click install. 
    - If the latest version is not working: **Untick Latest and select 0.7.2**

### Linux
1. Navigate to Muse Dash on steam, open properties and add the following to Launch Options: `WINEDLLOVERRIDES="version=n,b" %command%`
2. Download `MelonLoader.Installer.Linux` from https://github.com/LavaGang/MelonLoader/releases/latest and run it.
   - You may need to give it permissions to execute.
3. Select Muse Dash in the list of games.
    - If Muse Dash does not appear, click add game manually then browse to `MuseDash.exe`.
4. Click install. On first run, melonloader may install dotnet 6 in order to run.
    - If the latest version is not working: **Untick Latest and select 0.7.2**
    
### Mod Install
1.Download `ArchipelagoMuseDash.zip`.
2. Head to the Muse Dash folder and open up `/mods/`. If this folder does not exist, run the game and it should appear.
3. Extract the contents of the .zip file into mods. Ensure the files are not in a subfolder, this mod is not setup for that yet.
4. Run the game. If a new button appears on the start screen the mod was installed correctly.
v1.4.53.title: v1.5.35

v1.5.26.description:
# Changes
- Adds support for MEDIUM⁵ Echoes
- Should no longer need to complete all of the Rhythm Master Pack to play Echoes of SeraphiM in Archipelago

# Installation
### Melonloader
*Melonloader is required to play with this mod.  However reinstalling it is not required on update.*

1. Download MelonLoader.Installer.exe from https://github.com/LavaGang/MelonLoader/releases/latest and run it.
2. Choose the automated tab, click the select button and browse to `MuseDash.exe`.
    - You can find the folder in steam by finding the game in your library, right clicking it and choosing *Manage→Browse Local Files*.
    - If you click the bar at the top telling you your current folder, this will give you a path you can copy. If you paste that into the window popped up by **MelonLoader**, it will automatically go to the same folder.
3. The launcher will automatically default to the latest version. 
    - If the latest version is not working: **Untick Latest and select 0.6.6.**
4. Click install. Once finished run the game once.

### Mod Install

1.Download `ArchipelagoMuseDash.zip`.
2. Head to the Muse Dash folder and open up `/mods/`.
3. Extract the contents of the .zip file into mods.
   - Ensure that `ArchipelagoMuseDash.dll` and `Archipelago.MultiClient.Net.dll` are under `/mods/` and not within a sub folder.
4. Run the game. If a new button appears on the start screen the mod was installed correctly.
